name: Saterland (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, yellow and light blue with a broad yellow middle stripe, charged at the centre with the arms of Saterland (a crowned figure with a wheel on red).
history: The flag was designed by Bernd Stolle of Scharrel and approved by the Landkreis Cloppenburg in 1991.

features.role: Saterland arms — crowned figure with wheel on red
